lines: This plan covers 7 days, starting today.
For today, breakfast and lunch are off the plan: the day is already under way.
The shared dish is vegan: that is what Malo eats.
Yanis misses meals on Saturday and Wednesday: those shares are not counted.
Camille has not said what they need: their share is served like the table's.
The shares in this plan are served at the plate, as close as they can be, rather than adjusted mouth by mouth.

dishes.name: Lentil summer bowl
dishes.title: Lentils, courgette, tomatoes and couscous
dishes.method: Reheat the lentil portion, add the couscous, lemon juice and parsley, and serve warm.
dishes.why: A warm, summery bowl that uses fresh produce and reheats quickly.

dishes.name: Herbed lentil plate
dishes.title: Lentils, courgette, tomatoes and couscous
dishes.method: Reheat Anouk's sealed lentil portion first on clean equipment, add the couscous and parsley, then keep the box closed while the shared portion is handled.
dishes.why: A separate herbed plate keeps the meal simple and fresh.

dishes.name: Silken tofu berry oats
dishes.title: Silken tofu, oats, berries and banana
dishes.method: Blend the tofu with the banana, spoon over the oats and berries, and eat chilled.
dishes.why: A quick breakfast built from summer fruit and a whole protein food.

dishes.name: Cocoa tofu breakfast
dishes.title: Silken tofu, oats, berries and banana
dishes.method: Blend the tofu with the cocoa, spoon over the oats and berries, and eat chilled.
dishes.why: A different-tasting breakfast that remains quick and protein-centred.

dishes.name: Lentil couscous salad
dishes.title: Lentils, tomatoes, cucumber and couscous
dishes.method: Reheat the lentil portion, then fold through cucumber, lemon and mint and serve with the couscous from the box.
dishes.why: A bright lunch suited to warm weather and easy batch cooking.

dishes.name: Minted lentil salad
dishes.title: Lentils, tomatoes, cucumber and couscous
dishes.method: Reheat Anouk's sealed portion first on clean equipment, fold through cucumber and mint, and close the box before handling the shared food.
dishes.why: Fresh cucumber and mint make the batch feel different at lunchtime.

dishes.name: Smoky bean chilli
dishes.title: Bean chilli, rice, avocado and tomato
dishes.method: Reheat the chilli portion, add the rice, avocado and lime, and serve.
dishes.why: A satisfying batch meal with seasonal tomato and avocado.

dishes.name: Avocado bean bowl
dishes.title: Bean chilli, rice, avocado and tomato
dishes.method: Reheat Anouk's sealed chilli portion first on clean equipment, add rice and avocado, close the box, then handle the shared portion.
dishes.why: A creamy avocado topping gives the batch a new finish.

dishes.name: Tofu berry oats
dishes.title: Silken tofu, oats, berries and pear
dishes.method: Blend the tofu with the pear, spoon over the oats and berries, and eat chilled.
dishes.why: A regular, no-cook breakfast with fresh fruit.

dishes.name: Pear cocoa tofu oats
dishes.title: Silken tofu, oats, berries and pear
dishes.method: Blend the tofu, pear and cocoa, spoon over the oats and berries, and eat chilled.
dishes.why: A simple variation keeps the morning meal appealing.

dishes.name: Chilli stuffed sweet potato
dishes.title: Bean chilli, sweet potato, lettuce and lime
dishes.method: Reheat the chilli portion, split the sweet potato, and add lettuce and lime.
dishes.why: The same chilli becomes a soft stuffed potato with a crisp side.

dishes.name: Chilli potato plate
dishes.title: Bean chilli, sweet potato, lettuce and lime
dishes.method: Reheat Anouk's sealed chilli portion first on clean equipment, add sweet potato and lettuce, close the box, then handle the shared portion.
dishes.why: A fresh lettuce side changes the texture of the reheated meal.

dishes.name: Golden chickpea curry
dishes.title: Chickpea curry, barley, spinach and tomato
dishes.method: Reheat the curry portion, add barley, spinach and chopped tomato, and serve.
dishes.why: A fragrant plant-based dinner with greens and ripe tomatoes.

dishes.name: Tomato chickpea bowl
dishes.title: Chickpea curry, barley, spinach and tomato
dishes.method: Reheat Anouk's sealed curry portion first on clean equipment, add barley, spinach and tomato, close the box, then handle the shared portion.
dishes.why: The same curry gets a fresh tomato-and-spinach finish.

dishes.name: Apple tofu oats
dishes.title: Silken tofu, oats, apple and berries
dishes.method: Blend the tofu with half the apple, spoon over the oats, and top with the remaining apple and berries.
dishes.why: A five-minute breakfast that keeps the morning rhythm steady.

dishes.name: Cocoa apple tofu oats
dishes.title: Silken tofu, oats, apple and berries
dishes.method: Blend the tofu, half the apple and cocoa, then add oats, berries and the remaining apple.
dishes.why: Cocoa changes the flavour without adding a cooking task.

dishes.name: Curry barley salad
dishes.title: Chickpea curry, barley, cucumber and herbs
dishes.method: Reheat the curry portion, fold through cucumber, coriander and lemon, and serve with barley.
dishes.why: A cooler curry bowl suits a summer lunchtime.

dishes.name: Herbed curry barley
dishes.title: Chickpea curry, barley, cucumber and herbs
dishes.method: Reheat Anouk's sealed curry portion first on clean equipment, fold through cucumber and coriander, close the box, then handle the shared portion.
dishes.why: Fresh herbs and cucumber make the reheated lunch lighter.

dishes.name: Crisp tofu noodle bowl
dishes.title: Baked tofu, noodles, peppers and greens
dishes.method: Reheat the tofu portion, add noodles, spring onions and lime, and serve.
dishes.why: A quick noodle bowl brings a different texture to the week.

dishes.name: Lime tofu noodles
dishes.title: Baked tofu, noodles, peppers and greens
dishes.method: Reheat Anouk's sealed tofu portion first on clean equipment, add noodles and spring onions, close the box, then handle the shared portion.
dishes.why: Spring onions and noodles give the tofu a fresh, bright finish.

dishes.name: Peach tofu oats
dishes.title: Silken tofu, oats, peach and berries
dishes.method: Blend the tofu with half the peach, spoon over oats, and top with the remaining peach and berries.
dishes.why: Ripe peach makes this regular breakfast feel properly summery.

dishes.name: Peach cocoa tofu oats
dishes.title: Silken tofu, oats, peach and berries
dishes.method: Blend tofu, cocoa and half the peach, then add oats, berries and the remaining peach.
dishes.why: A cocoa variation keeps the breakfast from becoming repetitive.

dishes.name: Tofu noodle salad
dishes.title: Baked tofu, noodles, cucumber and herbs
dishes.method: Reheat the tofu portion, toss with noodles, cucumber, mint and lime, and serve.
dishes.why: A cool herb-filled bowl makes leftover tofu feel new.

dishes.name: Mint tofu noodle salad
dishes.title: Baked tofu, noodles, cucumber and herbs
dishes.method: Reheat Anouk's sealed tofu portion first on clean equipment, toss with noodles, cucumber and mint, close the box, then handle the shared portion.
dishes.why: Mint and cucumber give the separate plate a crisp finish.

dishes.name: Fresh chickpea curry
dishes.title: Chickpea curry, barley, courgette and spinach
dishes.method: Reheat the curry portion, add barley, courgette ribbons and spinach, and serve.
dishes.why: Courgette and spinach keep the curry light for a summer evening.

dishes.name: Courgette curry bowl
dishes.title: Chickpea curry, barley, courgette and spinach
dishes.method: Reheat Anouk's sealed curry portion first on clean equipment, add barley, courgette and spinach, close the box, then handle the shared portion.
dishes.why: The vegetables add freshness and colour to the final curry serving.

dishes.name: Plum tofu oats
dishes.title: Silken tofu, oats, plum and berries
dishes.method: Blend one plum with the tofu, spoon over oats, and top with the other plum and berries.
dishes.why: Seasonal plums make a fast breakfast feel varied.

dishes.name: Plum cocoa tofu oats
dishes.title: Silken tofu, oats, plum and berries
dishes.method: Blend one plum with tofu and cocoa, spoon over oats, and top with the other plum and berries.
dishes.why: The cocoa variation keeps the same easy morning structure appealing.

dishes.name: Tomato bean pasta
dishes.title: Bean tomato sauce, wholewheat pasta and courgette
dishes.method: Reheat the bean tomato sauce, add pasta, courgette ribbons and basil, and serve.
dishes.why: Tomatoes, courgette and basil make a familiar batch lunch feel summery.

dishes.name: Basil bean pasta
dishes.title: Bean tomato sauce, wholewheat pasta and courgette
dishes.method: Reheat Anouk's sealed sauce portion first on clean equipment, add pasta, courgette and basil, close the box, then handle the shared portion.
dishes.why: A basil-heavy finish gives the separate serving its own character.

dishes.name: Tofu tomato traybake
dishes.title: Baked tofu, potatoes, peppers and tomatoes
dishes.method: Reheat the tofu portion, add potatoes, pepper and tomato, and serve.
dishes.why: A colourful traybake-style bowl uses abundant summer vegetables.

dishes.name: Pepper tofu potato bowl
dishes.title: Baked tofu, potatoes, peppers and tomatoes
dishes.method: Reheat Anouk's sealed tofu portion first on clean equipment, add potatoes, pepper and tomato, close the box, then handle the shared portion.
dishes.why: Sweet pepper and tomato bring a fresh finish to the tofu.

dishes.name: Fig tofu oats
dishes.title: Silken tofu, oats, fig and berries
dishes.method: Blend one fig with the tofu, spoon over oats, and top with the remaining fig and berries.
dishes.why: Fresh figs give the final weekday breakfast a seasonal lift.

dishes.name: Fig cocoa tofu oats
dishes.title: Silken tofu, oats, fig and berries
dishes.method: Blend one fig with tofu and cocoa, spoon over oats, and top with the remaining fig and berries.
dishes.why: A final cocoa variation keeps the breakfast routine enjoyable.

dishes.name: Cold bean pasta salad
dishes.title: Bean tomato sauce, pasta, cucumber and basil
dishes.method: Use the chilled sauce portion, toss with pasta, cucumber and basil, and serve cold.
dishes.why: A cold pasta salad is practical and pleasant at the end of the week.

dishes.name: Cucumber bean pasta
dishes.title: Bean tomato sauce, pasta, cucumber and basil
dishes.method: Use Anouk's sealed chilled sauce portion first, toss with pasta, cucumber and basil, close the box, then handle the shared portion.
dishes.why: Cucumber keeps this separate serving crisp and light.

preparations.title: Lentil ratatouille
preparations.method: Rinse the lentils. Soften the onions in olive oil, add courgettes and tomatoes, stir in lentils and water, simmer until tender, then cool and portion into labelled boxes.

preparations.title: Bean chilli
preparations.method: Soften onions and peppers in olive oil, add tomatoes, beans, cumin and water, simmer until thick, cool, and portion into labelled boxes. Refrigerate portions for the next three days.

preparations.title: Chickpea curry
preparations.method: Soften onions and courgettes in olive oil, add curry powder, tomatoes, chickpeas and water, simmer until thick, cool, and portion into labelled boxes.

preparations.title: Baked tofu
preparations.method: Press and cube the tofu. Toss tofu, peppers and tomatoes with olive oil and lemon, bake until browned, cool, and portion into labelled boxes.

preparations.title: Bean tomato sauce
preparations.method: Soften onions and carrots in olive oil, add tomatoes and beans, simmer until thick, cool, and portion into labelled boxes. Refrigerate portions for Thursday and Friday.

cooking_sessions.run_through: Rinse the lentils, chop the vegetables, soften the onions, add the courgettes, tomatoes, lentils and water, simmer until tender, cool, and portion into labelled boxes.
Chop the onions and peppers, soften them, add tomatoes, beans, cumin and water, simmer until thick, cool, and portion into labelled boxes.
Start the oven for the tofu tray, chop the curry vegetables, begin the curry, prepare the tofu tray while it simmers, bake the tofu, cool both preparations, and portion into labelled boxes.
Chop the onions and carrots, soften them in oil, add tomatoes and beans, simmer until thick, cool, and portion into labelled boxes.
